body.name: Completed coordinatewise-endpoint label fan
body.construction: Use the fixed semantic assertion list \(\mathscr A_{\mathrm{JC}}\). Evaluate the complete rational branch and endpoint-program cut list at \(p_0\); freeze every nonzero base sign, retain only zero-base cuts with nonzero tangent normal \(B^{\prime}\alpha_{\psi}\), and treat zero tangent normals as fixed ties. Enumerate every incident weak completion of this active arrangement. For each semantic pattern \(v\), form the closed rational tangent cell \(P_{v,b}^0\), include equality faces in every incident cell, discard empty cells, and set \(D_v^0=\bigcup_bP_{v,b}^0\). Flatten \((v,b)\) only for recession computation and project honesty, actions, and loss back to \(v\).
inputs: the fixed Job Corps assertion list \(\mathscr A_{\mathrm{JC}}\)
